dnaDigievolution.title: DNA Digievolutions
dnaDigievolution.description:
These are all the DNA Digievolutions available in the game. This list does not reflect immediate availability and is for informational purposes only.

A DNA Digievolution happens when you perform a Tag between your Digimons in battle selecting two Digievolutions that are compatible.

When a DNA Digievolution becomes available to use, the Digievolutions involved will be highlighted for you.

effect.reviveAndFullHealAll: Revive and fully heal all Digimons
